items.title: How Multi-Agent AI Is Changing the Way CPG and Retail Brands Manage Advertising at Scale
items.summary: A consumer packaged goods (CPG) brand advertising across multiple categories—snacks, beverages, personal care, household essentials—can easily accumulate hundreds of active Sponsored Products campaigns, well within Amazon’s 10,000-campaign account limit. Its campaign analyst starts Monday morning like this: They open the reporting dashboard to check weekend performance. The back-to-school snacks campaign dropped 22 percent in return […]
